original_question: There are 36 penguins sunbathing in the snow. One-third of them jump in and swim in the ocean. Another one-third go inside the cave to eat their dinner. How many penguins are still left sunbathing?
question_template: There are {num_digit_1, 36} penguins sunbathing in the snow. {num_frac_1, One-third} of them jump in and swim in the ocean. Another {num_frac_2, one-third} go inside the cave to eat their dinner. How many penguins are still left sunbathing?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * (1 - f1 - f2)   # f1 and f2 are the numeric values of num_frac_1 and num_frac_2
